2316.description: 2KB mask ROM with 3 configurable CS lines

2332.description: 4KB mask ROM with 2 configurable CS lines

2364.description: 8KB mask ROM with 1 configurable CS line

23128.description: 16KB mask ROM with 3 configurable CS lines

23256.description: 32KB mask ROM with 2 configurable CS lines

23QL384.description: A composite ROM type, serving a combined 23256 and 23128 for the Sinclair QL, with a single configured CS line and is de-selected when A14 & A15 are both high

23QL512.description: A composite ROM type, serving two combined 23256s for the Sinclair QL, with a single configured CS line at pin 22, and A15 at pin 20 instead of pin 1

23512.description: 64KB mask ROM with 2 configurable CS lines

231024.description: 128KB mask ROM with 1 configurable CS line

23C1010.description: 128KB mask ROM with fixed active-low CE/OE

HM7641.description: 512B bipolar PROM with three-state outputs and four fixed-polarity chip selects

2732.description: 4KB EPROM with fixed active-low CE and shared OE/VPP

23C1001.description: 128KB mask programmed ROM with fixed active-low CE/OE, plus 2 programmable CS lines

SST39SF040.description: 512KB flash with fixed active-low CE/OE and different pinout to 27C040

27C080.notes: One ROM canot serve an entire 27C080, as it is a 1MB ROM.  However it can be programmed as a 27C080 with CS1 indicating which half of the ROM to serve, which is pin A19.  Two 32 pin One ROMs can be stacked with different CS1 configuration, and each with half a 27C080 image, to serve the entire 1MB ROM

27C200.description: 0.25MB mask programmed EPROM with fixed active-low CE/OE
27C200.notes: It's unclear whether 27C200 was ever used as a moniker for this ROM type, but I'm assuming it was.

6116.description: 2KB (2048 x 8-bit) Static RAM with fixed active-low CE/OE/WE
